posts.title: 2026 Album Roundup #11
posts.description: Wew heading to the end of the year and some dope releases the past month. Popstar - Tinashe Finally listened to it and dang this is niiiiiiiice. Fun, catchy, pop R&B beats, what's not to like? There are some forgettable tracks but the highlights like Melatonin, Sunglasses, and Crash Out are dope. Weight of the Reality Beneath - Train Breaks Down I found this by searching best post-hardcore albums

posts.description: Wew into the Autumn with some dope new albums. Rebecca Black - Age of the Exhibitionist First of all, here for the Rebecca Black comeback. Friday was a cultural moment and the hate a literal teenage girl got for that song is wild. But this is a fun pop album.
